scope: Coordinator scheduling, with peer controls and staging mocked. Gameplay and transaction code are unchanged.
scenario: Both peers are safe, useful trade proposals exist, the trade cooldown has expired, and pending rewards remain through four fresh coordinator instances.
validated_guards: No useful trade keeps reward delivery active
Unavailable board does not block pending rewards
Skipped attempts cannot starve the other operation
live_motivation: The 13:24 sample had twelve completed trades, more than an hour since the last exchange, continuing Championship wins, and pending rewards. Safe-point availability also contributes to latency.
